verdict.rationale: Riveter is presented throughout as a hosted cloud API/SaaS (enrichment, scraping, search endpoints, webhooks, MCP remote connector at mcp.riveterhq.com); the only 'runs on your machine' component is a local MCP proxy for connecting to the remote API, not the core enrichment engine itself. No evidence of an open-source repo, self-hosted deployment option, or on-prem installer for the core product.
